event: gh pr create prints the URL of the pull request
shows: gh pr create --title "Pull request title" --body "Pull request body" http://github.com/owner/repo/pull/1

event: gh pr ready marks the pull request ready
shows: Mark a pull request as ready for review.

event: gh issue create prints the URL of the issue
shows: gh issue create --title "Issue title" --body "Issue body" http://github.com/owner/repo/issues/1
